profiles.rationale: Reviewed market-composition helper: retain the inspected active supply mix and freight quantities, using only the existing resolved directional component mappings for this exact source profile. The source has a unit-magnitude reference, active technosphere inputs only and no direct biosphere exchanges. Apply each component's reference-sign factor independently: negative inputs to negative treatment references are treatment demand, whereas negative inputs to positive product references are recovery credits. No component omission, empty allocation or missing-provider fallback is used. These helpers inherit the component correspondences' heuristic, technology, composition, geography and allocation approximations; resolved signs do not establish scientific or LCIA equivalence. Internal component uncertainty and parameter formulas are not reconstructed. Preserve caller-owned signed quantities, uncertainty, formulas, foreground suppliers, production and separate emissions. Score and export all returned helpers. Missing or changed exact profiles require a new review; no reverse correspondence is inferred. Follow-up older regional road correction retains every signed source coefficient: complete RER heavy-lorry fleet for original all-sizes road markets. Geographic fleet, vintage and inventory differences remain screening limitations; no inverse is inferred.

source: silica fume, densified, Recycled Content cut-off
market group for transport, freight train
market group for transport, freight, lorry, unspecified

profiles.rationale: Reviewed exact-profile inventory assembly with explicitly approved cut-off allocation supplies: retain every original processing, supply, freight and signed recovery coefficient. Independently inspected positive-reference Recycled Content cut-off stocks have production only and retain that allocation boundary as separate foreground suppliers. Negative stock inputs remain product credits with the source allocation burden; negative inputs to negative treatment references remain treatment demand and use their own sign factors. No actual recycling/treatment stage, uncharacterized inventory, unknown supplier or negative-reference empty service is assigned zero. Other resolved component correspondences retain their technology, geography, composition and allocation approximations; scientific and LCIA equivalence is not established. Internal background uncertainty/formulas are not reconstructed. Preserve caller signed quantities, uncertainty/formulas, foreground suppliers, production and separate emissions/credits. Export and score the entire returned helper hierarchy. Only the enumerated verified profiles are approved; explicitly pending counterpart profiles remain blocked and no reverse is inferred. Follow-up whole-freight review: in the enumerated cut-off profiles, preserve every signed freight coefficient while selecting complete same-mode and matching vehicle-class supplies. Light-commercial freight uses the inspected CH 3.5t light-duty fleet; generic heavy-diesel freight uses the complete RER multi-class/multi-duty diesel fleet; generic rail and inland barge use complete RER services. Vehicle manufacture, maintenance, end-of-life and road/track infrastructure are already included. Country, fuel, payload, vintage, EURO class and duty mixtures differ, including petrol/diesel versus the mixed CH light-duty fleet and global steam/diesel/electric rail versus RER rail. No payload or distance scaling, extra vehicle/infrastructure, arbitrary individual steam substitution, physical omission, recovered-material/energy policy change or inferred inverse is introduced. All other components, genuine credits, source quantities and source inventories remain unchanged. Historical consequential recipe bodies and coefficients are retained solely as provenance, not executable routes. Evidence: brightpath/data/export/uvek_whole_freight_review.json.

profiles.rationale: Reviewed exact-profile inventory assembly with explicitly approved cut-off allocation supplies: retain every original processing, supply, freight and signed recovery coefficient. Independently inspected positive-reference Recycled Content cut-off stocks have production only and retain that allocation boundary as separate foreground suppliers. Negative stock inputs remain product credits with the source allocation burden; negative inputs to negative treatment references remain treatment demand and use their own sign factors. No actual recycling/treatment stage, uncharacterized inventory, unknown supplier or negative-reference empty service is assigned zero. Other resolved component correspondences retain their technology, geography, composition and allocation approximations; scientific and LCIA equivalence is not established. Internal background uncertainty/formulas are not reconstructed. Preserve caller signed quantities, uncertainty/formulas, foreground suppliers, production and separate emissions/credits. Export and score the entire returned helper hierarchy. Only the enumerated verified profiles are approved; explicitly pending counterpart profiles remain blocked and no reverse is inferred. Follow-up whole-freight review: in the enumerated cut-off profiles, preserve every signed freight coefficient while selecting complete same-mode and matching vehicle-class supplies. Light-commercial freight uses the inspected CH 3.5t light-duty fleet; generic heavy-diesel freight uses the complete RER multi-class/multi-duty diesel fleet; generic rail and inland barge use complete RER services. Vehicle manufacture, maintenance, end-of-life and road/track infrastructure are already included. Country, fuel, payload, vintage, EURO class and duty mixtures differ, including petrol/diesel versus the mixed CH light-duty fleet and global steam/diesel/electric rail versus RER rail. No payload or distance scaling, extra vehicle/infrastructure, arbitrary individual steam substitution, physical omission, recovered-material/energy policy change or inferred inverse is introduced. All other components, genuine credits, source quantities and source inventories remain unchanged. Historical consequential recipe bodies and coefficients are retained solely as provenance, not executable routes. Evidence: brightpath/data/export/uvek_whole_freight_review.json.

Country, fuel, payload, vintage, EURO class and duty mixtures differ, including petrol/diesel versus the mixed CH light-duty fleet and global steam/diesel/electric rail versus RER rail. No payload or distance scaling, extra vehicle/infrastructure, arbitrary individual steam substitution, physical omission, recovered-material/energy policy change or inferred inverse is introduced. All other components, genuine credits, source quantities and source inventories remain unchanged. Historical consequential recipe bodies and coefficients are retained solely as provenance, not executable routes. Evidence: brightpath/data/export/uvek_whole_freight_review.json.

source.reference product: spent sawing slurry from Si-wafer cutting

rules.review_rationale: Reviewed market-composition helper: retain both inspected regional sawing-slurry treatment shares without rounding, normalization, freight insertion or component omission. The 3.6 source has a self-linked -1 litre reference and only two active negative treatment demands. Each child has its own independently reviewed -1 sign conversion to a positive litre helper. Retain the cut-off treatment boundary or consequential silicon-carbide/glycol credits of the selected children. These helpers inherit the component correspondences' heuristic, electricity mix, chemical-plant infrastructure, waste treatment, material composition, geography, allocation, upstream supply and emissions approximations. No litre-to-mass or slurry-spreading substitution is used. Internal uncertainty/formulas are not reconstructed. Preserve caller signs, supported uncertainty and formulas, foreground suppliers and separate emissions. Score/export all generated helpers. Newer sludge treatment boundaries, unknown patches and the reverse direction are not approved. Follow-up whole-freight review: in the enumerated cut-off profiles, preserve every signed freight coefficient while selecting complete same-mode and matching vehicle-class supplies. Light-commercial freight uses the inspected CH 3.5t light-duty fleet; generic heavy-diesel freight uses the complete RER multi-class/multi-duty diesel fleet; generic rail and inland barge use complete RER services. Vehicle manufacture, maintenance, end-of-life and road/track infrastructure are already included. Country, fuel, payload, vintage, EURO class and duty mixtures differ, including petrol/diesel versus the mixed CH light-duty fleet and global steam/diesel/electric rail versus RER rail. No payload or distance scaling, extra vehicle/infrastructure, arbitrary individual steam substitution, physical omission, recovered-material/energy policy change or inferred inverse is introduced. All other components, genuine credits, source quantities and source inventories remain unchanged. Historical consequential recipe bodies and coefficients are retained solely as provenance, not executable routes. Evidence: brightpath/data/export/uvek_whole_freight_review.json.

profiles.rationale: Exact cut-off textile-waste market composition. Retain source landfill shares and all four transport quantities without normalization. Both landfill components retain their own unsanitary-disposal releases; no jute-production or controlled-landfill substitution. Freight uses complete existing same-mode services with their geography, fleet, payload, vintage and technology limitations; no capacity/lifetime scaling or duplicate vehicle/infrastructure. Native physical-coverage refusals and warnings remain independent. Preserve caller signs, uncertainty, formulas, foreground suppliers and separate emissions; no consequential or inverse mapping is inferred. The complete diesel operating service uses Swiss fleet/filter/vintage assumptions and the complete skid-steer excavation service uses a RER proxy for the original GLO operating backgrounds; their technology, geography, emission factors and background supply differ. Internal source parameter formulas and uncertainty are not reconstructed. No additional purchased diesel, machinery, landfill control or recovery credit is introduced.

re_review_batches.limitations: Reviewed market-composition helper: retain both inspected regional sawing-slurry treatment shares without rounding, normalization, freight insertion or component omission. The 3.6 source has a self-linked -1 litre reference and only two active negative treatment demands. Each child has its own independently reviewed -1 sign conversion to a positive litre helper. Retain the cut-off treatment boundary or consequential silicon-carbide/glycol credits of the selected children. These helpers inherit the component correspondences' heuristic, electricity mix, chemical-plant infrastructure, waste treatment, material composition, geography, allocation, upstream supply and emissions approximations. No litre-to-mass or slurry-spreading substitution is used. Internal uncertainty/formulas are not reconstructed. Preserve caller signs, supported uncertainty and formulas, foreground suppliers and separate emissions. Score/export all generated helpers. Newer sludge treatment boundaries, unknown patches and the reverse direction are not approved.
